findings.detail: Priority 1 recommendation "Add descriptive alt text…" lacks a specific data anchor (no selector, URL or count) and could be copy‑pasted into any audit report.
Priority 2 recommendation "Order headings without skipping levels…" is generic; no page, selector or count is referenced.
Priority 3 recommendation to wrap content in a <main> landmark provides only a domain‑level fix with no specific element reference.
Priority 4 recommendation to replace landmark containers and give remaining containers meaningful class names is generic, lacking any selector or page anchor.
